meta.name: Overgeared
meta.description: Escape everyday life in SATISFY, a VR game where players earn real-world fame and fortune. One player, Grid, can't seem to catch a break in the game or in real life. That all changes when a challenging quest leads him to becoming the heir to a legendary blacksmith. His stats are reset to zero, but he's leveling up and crafting some seriously god-tier goods.

videos.title: Legendary Class
videos.overview: Grid hopes to strike it rich in the VR game Satisfy. While taking on an S-Ranked quest, he discovers Pagma’s Tome.

videos.title: First Step Towards Being a Blacksmith
videos.overview: Grid has made a fresh start. With nowhere else to turn, he begins learning the fundamentals of blacksmithing.

videos.title: Second Class
videos.overview: The Mero Company sends Huroi, an Orator, to the village. There, he forcibly triggers a hidden quest...!?

videos.title: Item Crafting Face-Off
videos.overview: Grid faces Euphemina in a blacksmithing contest. The contest turns into an S-Ranked quest to rescue Huroi.

videos.title: Family's Trust
videos.overview: Grid continues his blacksmithing. He puts up an epic armor for auction, and gets a request for more.

videos.title: First Boss Raid
videos.overview: Grid goes with Khan to visit his son's grave. He gets a new job quest: to learn "Pagma's Sword Dance."

videos.title: Pagma's Sword Dance
videos.overview: Grid heads to Kesan Canyon for his job quest. On the way, he meets his old bullies from the real world.

videos.title: Yatan's High Priest
videos.overview: Grid is asked to make the Divine Shield. He completes it, but the Yatan Church steals it.

videos.title: Comrades in the Guild
videos.overview: Grid fights in a raid against Malaxus. Malaxus is almost defeated when he turns the tide with powerful magic…
